blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s choice of witnesses for her impeachment trial has done little to rescue her defense and may instead have driven her deeper into an “impeachment sinkhole,” former Rep. Robert Ace Barbers, House impeachment adviser and spokesperson, said in a statement on Tuesday. Barbers said the defense’s failure to present several witnesses who could have directly addressed the allegations of undeclared wealth cited under the second impeachment article left critical questions unanswered. “When the defense had the opportunity to bring forward witnesses who could have clarified and rebutted these allegations, such as her alleged P817 million undeclared […]...
